title: Emile Henry “Gastron” Ceramic Plate – Made in France – Yellow Hexagon Dish
description:
Beautiful Emile Henry ceramic plate in a vibrant yellow glaze. This elegant hexagonal dish is part of the Gastron line and showcases the high-quality craftsmanship that the French brand is known for.
Made in France, this durable ceramic piece is perfect for serving appetizers, desserts, or small dishes, and also works wonderfully as a decorative kitchen or table piece.
Details:
• Brand: Emile Henry
• Line: Gastron
• Shape: Hexagonal
• Color: Yellow glaze
• Material: High-quality ceramic
• Made in France
• Marked on the base: Emile Henry – Gastron – 34.27
Condition:
Good vintage condition with light signs of use on the base consistent with age. The glaze remains bright and attractive.
A lovely addition for Emile Henry collectors, French kitchenware lovers, or anyone who enjoys classic French tableware.
